guidance.statement: FY27 revenue growth guided at 20% to 22%
FY27 EBITDA margin guided at around 11%
FY27 order intake guided at INR 10,000 crores to INR 11,000 crores

status_history.evidence: YTD order intake reached ₹3,356 Cr against FY27 guidance of ₹10,000-11,000 Cr.

industry: Industrials > Capital Goods > Electrical Equipment > Heavy Electrical Equipment

operating_notes.text: Tower manufacturing capacity increased to 1,72,400 MTPA following greenfield expansion at Butibori and brownfield expansions at Deoli, Baroda and Silvassa.
Board approved ₹203 Cr capex plan and voluntary winding up of inactive subsidiary Transrail Lighting Malaysia SDN. BHD.
Operating cash flows for FY26 reached ₹817 crore, nearly double of last year.
Bidding pipeline stands at ₹80,000-1,00,000 Cr in domestic and ~₹50,000 Cr in international markets.
Working capital cycle improved from 91 days in FY25 to 81 days in FY26, targeting sub-80 days.
Acquiring 49% stake in NOPL Pace Green Energy for ₹20 Cr; target is developing 990 MW solar portfolio in Maharashtra.
990 MW solar portfolio has 25-year PPA with MSEDCL at ₹3.10/unit; estimated project cost ₹3,900 Cr.
Secured fresh orders worth ₹927 Cr, taking YTD FY27 order intake to ₹3,356 Cr; includes 765kV & 400kV domestic T&D lines and US conductor export orders.

timeline.summary: Transrail Lighting completed greenfield and partial brownfield expansions, raising its tower manufacturing capacity to 1,72,400 MTPA.
Transrail Lighting Limited scheduled an earnings call for audited Q4FY26 results on May 27, 2026, at 3:00 PM IST with **Mr. Randeep Narang (MD & CEO)** and **Mr. Deepak Khandelwal (CFO)**.
Transrail Lighting received an appellate GST order confirming a demand of ₹8.23 Cr and penalty of ₹42.74 Cr for FY20.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,863.46 Cr, net profit ₹96.5 Cr.
Transrail Lighting Limited hosted an earnings call on May 27, 2026, at 15:00 IST, presenting audited Q4FY26 and FY26 results via Monica Gandhi, signed digitally by Tanay Gandhi.
2026-06-02: Transrail Lighting Limited secures new orders worth ₹575 crore and holds L1 position of around ₹400 crore
Transrail Lighting hosted its Q4FY26 earnings call, guiding for 20-22% revenue growth and ~11% EBITDA margins in FY27 supported by a ₹16,361 Cr order book.
2026-10-14: Transrail Lighting Limited secures new orders worth ₹408 crore, including a GIS substation project in MENA region, taking YTD order intake to ₹2,429 crore
Transrail Lighting approved the acquisition of a 49% stake in NOPL Pace Green Energy, which is developing a 990 MW solar portfolio in Maharashtra for ₹3,900 Cr.
Secured fresh orders worth ₹927 crore in power T&D and conductor export businesses, taking YTD order intake to ₹3,356 crore.
